researchTasks: [Medium] Model/provider, age, retention and generated text ownership: Please provide the model/provider list, education-specific retention schedule, minimum age, output ownership and any teacher/administrator access to learner activity. (route: Grammarly for Education sales; evidence wanted: Education DPA, Trust Center, terms, AI model disclosure)

Confirm current pricing, market availability, integrations/standards, accessibility, security evidence and commercial relationship. Complete blank AI fields from current vendor terms/help/trust documentation; record a separate source per field.
Ask vendor (How long prompts and chats are kept): What are prompt/chat retention periods, subprocessors and data residency options for Grammarly for Education?
Ask vendor (Who processes the data): What are prompt/chat retention periods, subprocessors and data residency options for Grammarly for Education?
Ask vendor (Minimum learner age): What minimum age applies to Grammarly for Education and which consent terms apply to school-age learners?
Ask vendor (Staff can review AI output before learners see it): Can staff review AI-generated content before learners see it or before grades/feedback are released?
Ask vendor (Staff can set limits on the AI): Can administrators/educators set topic, prompt, feature, or access restrictions?
Ask vendor (Staff can see learner conversations): Can staff see learner conversations? Which roles can access them, and can this be disabled?
Ask vendor (Answers from your own course content): Can the AI answer from customer-provided course content or institutional knowledge? Can this be restricted to approved content?
Ask vendor (Shows its sources): Does the AI show citations or source references for answers grounded in uploaded/course content?
Ask vendor (Who owns what the AI produces): Who owns generated/revised text and does Grammarly receive any licence to retain or reuse it?

Researcher note (dataPrivacy), not shown until sourced: Grammarly distinguishes model training from product improvement. Product Improvement and Training is off by default for Grammarly for Education and qualifying sales-managed accounts.

Researcher note (outputOwnership), not shown until sourced: Do not treat Grammarly's general writing features as a dedicated tutor. Need exact education privacy, retention, AI provider and generated-output rights terms.
